div.b: Command to Command via Pause in Correlated Park-and-Resume Navigation:
div.span: The active thread initiates 3DS and calls .pauseUntilResume(Duration.ofMinutes(20)). The 20m parameter defines the Maximum Retention Time (TTL window) to park in the DB while thread and locks are released. When the external 3DS callback arrives, SEC immediately awakens the saga and dispatches CapturePaymentCommandExecutor. If no callback arrives within 20m, the parked state expires and is exposed for retrying/recovery.
